assertions.assertion: The appeal is for a CO-22 denial
CPT 93229 is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
The clinical indication documents intermittent palpitations
The diagnosis code for palpitations is R00.2
The clinical indication documents episodes of dizziness
The diagnosis code for dizziness is R42
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code for nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is I34.0
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data
The purpose is to correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias
CO-22 asserts coordination of benefits rather than a clinical determination
